title: Night-Time Motion Anomaly Baseline
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=frigate:event label=person
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| where hour>=1 AND hour<=4
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as night_person_events by _time camera
| eventstats avg(night_person_events) as usual by camera
| where night_person_events>usual+3
description: Learns how much person-motion is normal in the small hours and flags a night with far more than usual.
value: Most late-night motion is harmless, but a sharp spike above your own baseline is exactly the kind of thing worth a look.
implementation: Ingest person detections; schedule each morning and alert when overnight activity exceeds the camera's baseline.
visualization: Time chart of overnight person events per camera with baseline band.
grandmaExplanation: It learns how much movement is normal at night and warns you if there is a lot more than usual.
